name: Webifysys Min/Max Quantities for WooCommerce
author: webifysys

sections.description:
Webifysys Min/Max Quantities for WooCommerce allows you to take full control over your store’s quantity rules.
You can set minimum, maximum, and step quantities for products, variations, and categories, as well as apply rules globally to the entire store.

The plugin automatically enforces these rules on the frontend, ensuring customers can only purchase within the limits you define. Perfect for wholesale stores, bulk order management, or shops needing custom quantity logic.

🔹 Key Features

  • Global Rules – Define default min, max, and step quantities for the entire store.
  • Per-Product Rules – Set unique quantity restrictions for individual products.
  • Per-Variation Rules – Customize quantity rules for each variation of a variable product.
  • Per-Category Rules – Assign min/max quantity rules for specific product categories.
  • Cart-Level Rules – Limit total cart quantity or value with customizable settings.
  • Frontend Enforcement – Rules are applied directly on the product and cart pages.
  • WooCommerce Compatible – Works seamlessly with WooCommerce’s default functionality.
  • Clean, intuitive admin interface with responsive design.

🎯 Perfect For:

  • Wholesale and B2B stores requiring bulk purchase limits.
  • Restricting low-quantity orders to save on shipping costs.
  • Setting strict purchase limits for promotional or limited-edition items.
  • Enforcing proper packaging and bundle sizes.

Support

For help, feature requests, or customizations, visit Webifysys or contact our support team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webimiqu-webifysys-min-max-quantities-for-woocommerce directory, or install it directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Min/Max Quantities Settings to configure global and category-level rules.
  4. Edit individual products or variations to set product-specific quantity rules.
  5. Save changes and test on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! You can set rules for each variation individually or apply global rules to all variations.

Will this affect my existing WooCommerce functionality?

No. The plugin integrates smoothly with WooCommerce without interfering with core functionality or other plugins.

Can I set different rules for different product categories?

Absolutely. The Per-Category Rules feature lets you manage quantity limits for each category independently.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, the admin interface is fully responsive, making it easy to manage rules on any device.
